integrity: New proof and finite checks are same-model-reviewed. The numerical test suite is supplementary, not an infinite proof. Historical priority has not been independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Proved for sufficiently large even complete grids after erasing the antipodal density-zero pair only; all positive gamma; first-order one-dimensional periodic Korobov kernel and exact sine density. No accuracy gain or extension to arbitrary subsampling is claimed.
title: A sharp two-erasure positivity gain for sine-periodized Korobov quadrature
